# wso2is_fraud_detection_configuration (Resource)

Manages how the server sends events to a fraud detection service. The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `fraud_detection_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_fraud_detection_configuration" "this" {
  publish_user_info   = true
  log_request_payload = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `log_request_payload` (Boolean) Log the payload sent to the fraud detection service.
- `publish_device_metadata` (Boolean) Include device metadata in events.
- `publish_user_info` (Boolean) Include user information in events.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `fraud_detection_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_fraud_detection_configuration.this fraud_detection_configuration
```
